title: Add an HTTP route (gateway.paths[]) to config.yaml

dataSource.description: Where to read the payload from (default: query for GET, body otherwise).

topic.description: Broker topic the request forwards to.

action.description: Broker action invoked on that topic.

auth.description: Auth-provider name that must verify the caller.

allowAnonymous.description: Allow anonymous callers even when auth is set.

actions.description: Actions the caller must hold (OR-semantics) — gated via the ACL. Requires auth.

binary.description: Return the reply as a raw binary buffer.

redirect.description: Respond with this redirect status instead of a body.

parseRaw.description: Forward the raw (unparsed) request body — needs rawBody:true at bootstrap.

overwrite.description: Update the entry if it already exists (default: leave it untouched).
